 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A solid nonzero divider separates two binary masks; output their overlap.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    if div_rows:
        r = div_rows[0]
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(top, bottom)]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] != 0 and len(set(row)) == 1 for row in [])]
    # Vertical divider is a column constant across all rows.
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if div_cols:
        c = div_cols[0]
        return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(row[:c], row[c + 1:])] for row in grid]
    return []
"
}
